tags.desc: Attacks, attempted attacks and foiled attacks inside Israel. Not celebrity or entertainment stories that only mention a security scare.
IDF conduct in combat, war-crime allegations, the IDF's image in Israel and abroad.
West Bank and settlements. Settler violence (assaults, arson, nationalist crime and arrests over them) moves the post to theme כאוס ומשילות פנימית.
Syria, Egypt, Jordan, the Gulf states and other regional actors when no specific front tag fits.
Failures of state institutions and the security establishment.
Reservists, their burden, compensation and protests.
The debate over the war ending without victory or a decisive outcome.

Campaigns, ads, candidates and statements of Israeli parties other than Likud and ישר! (e.g. Shas, Yisrael Beytenu, the Democrats, Otzma Yehudit), including their leaders' reactions to a war event, strike or scandal when the reaction is the headline.
Likud primaries, reserved slots and list placements, Likud campaign messaging, and Likud ministers' and MKs' reactions to events when the reaction is the headline.
Central Elections Committee, dates, disqualifications and voting procedures.
New parties entering the race, mergers, joint runs, alliances between parties, and politicians joining or leaving a party (e.g. Ofer Winter's עמך, Gilad Erdan's new party).
Gadi Eisenkot's party ישר! (Yashar!): its campaign, candidates, new recruits and Eisenkot's statements. Only this party; other parties' campaigns are not ישר!.

Stability of the sitting government's coalition: crises between coalition partners, partners threatening to quit, ultimatums and votes that test the coalition. Not new parties or post-election coalition scenarios.
Elections and domestic politics in other countries, unrelated to Israel.
